You're my possession.
My little doll.
This is the beginning of hell for #C236196003#FAMILY #GIVEN#CDEF.

Guh…!
Not yet, not yet…!
#C236196003Archer#CDEF reanimates his failing body.
#C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF's spike pierces my body.

Damn you…
Damn you, #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF―――!
Guh… bgh…!
Now you belong to me, #C236196003Archer#CDEF.
…I hear heavy heels click against the ground…
…I'm sorry, #C236196003Archer#CDEF…
Welcome inside of me.

Yeah―――It's a bit late for this,
but I just realized something.
She's a bee. The one and only queen bee that rules the colony.

But―――We're inside of my mind.
So long as I fight in here, my level is set
to its default value. Also―――
Infiltrating me means I also infiltrate you.

I can't, it won't cut! This is bad!
All the ICE around #C236196003Sakura#CDEF is melting!
Ah―――Ahh, aahhHhh!
#C236196003Elizabeth#CDEF, #C236196003Passionlip#CDEF, even #C236196003BB#CDEF never laid a finger on #C236196003Sakura#CDEF…!

Those birthed by the creator cannot harm
#C236196003White Sakura#CDEF.

Not #C000246204Alter Egos#CDEF, not Shapeshifters, not hostile
programs. No one.

It's laughable.
Even now, #C236196003BB#CDEF cherishes the bed she was born in.

Yes. That's the best solution.
It's smart. Yeah, smart.

A wind whips up.
I feel the staggering pressure.

…you picked the wrong guy, #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF. You and
I are a BAD match. It seems that I have a
tendency to put others before myself.

Okay, Darling. Guide me!
Please show her what REAL love looks like!
…so much so that #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF martyred herself for her love.

Even if that love was wrong.
She challenged us with such intense emotions―――
―is up to you.

Letting her go won't save her…
You decide what happens to #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF's mind.

We could just leave her here, but if she
self-destructs in an ugly way, we won't be
able to leave her mind.
I should――
………I can't do it.
………I can't do it.#C246168255薗#CDEF

Fine, let's see you try.
Will you be able to break my mind?
Were you worth me pining over you?

Fine, try it. Will you be able to break my #RUBS mind#RUBElove#REND?
Were you a woman worth being my rival in love?
I can't do it.
Even if she IS our enemy…

It's funny.
A fitting end for someone born from #C236196003BB#CDEF…

Ahh―――So, far―――
Yet so, close―――
I'll―――
…have my Servant stop her.
…let her keep going.
…let her keep going.#C246168255薗#CDEF
#C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF fades like petals scattered in the wind.

…that'll do.
This was for the best, Master.
…let's hurry.
Ah―――Ahh, ah―――
…#C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF puts out her arm.

―――No, how could I?
It would just be, plain shameless of you, #C236196003Melt#CDEF.

"Just one touch"?
Ha―――How silly. The loser should only
get to hold sand. It's fine, #C236196003#NICK#CDEF.
Saying so, #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF lowers her arm.

And yet―――
On her face is a fearless smile typical of her.

…I'm letting you go.
Leave at any time.

Go on and get out of my sight.
I've had enough of you two.

I'm honored by your compliment.
Now, will you please get lost?

…*sigh*. There they go.
Farewell, my love.
Farewell, you wonderful person.
Wha――!?

! So that's what you did!
Your slip up was actually―――!

aAH―――!
How dare, how, da―――
You, used us―――!

Don't you plan to disgrace and torment me
until I can never speak of love again?
Go ahead. Say whatever you please.

My love is complete.
It's not some botched love that can't
form without your love.
I say―――
Damn… I went too easy on #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF…
I say―――
Khh……!
…yeah. Her #C000246204Sadism#CDEF shows in how she relates to others.
Does such a thing exist…?
Everyone―――Even #C236196003Shinji#CDEF changed.
She sneered at me…
#C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF's mania: her love towards dolls.

"…gave up on receiving love," huh…
I have to give it to you, that one hit hard.

It's still not too late.
How about you become mine?

My ideal lover.
My one and only prince.

…so, don't get in my way.
I'm saying that I'll give him what you can't.

Then do as I say.
I'll use enough of my #RUBS  love #RUBEnectar#REND to
drown and choke you…
Crime Ballet
All Drain
That's right, what am I saying…?

A disguised #C000246204SG#CDEF won't do any damage to #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF.
The skill clogging her mind is―――

*kgh*…!
Ha, haa, aaAhhh…!

Haa… haa… haa… haa…
I wondered―――what you would say.
My #C000246204All Drain#CDEF is my flaw…?

Yeah.
She's an AI that was born with this special skill, "#C000246204All Drain#CDEF."
This peculiarity ended up fixing who #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF is.

T-that's…
But, if I just melt everything down―――
If I turn billions of people into me…!
The moment she uses #C000246204All Drain#CDEF, her love gets closed off.

…stop.
Stop this. Stop it now.
I'm fine with that. It's fine.

I despise humans, anyway.
An open love has no value.
I can produce many #RUBS   people#RUBEof myself#REND.
…she finally said it.
She said, "lonely."
……#C000246204Alter Ego#CDEF, #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF.
You're―――
Gah…!
You're―――

So…
Yeah. Of course I'm… all alone.
That one word broke #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF's mind.

…I have to shower her with more truth in her weakened state.
I'm here to expose her mind, after all.

#C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF said it:
"Of course I'm all alone."
That's who you really are, #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF.

I want to be alone because I love.
There's no need for words…
…kgh, is that so…?
Ha…. ah, ah, ah…!

Ahh… ah…
I know… I know―――

Then, tell me:
what's wrong with me?
What's insane about me?

…hee, hee hee hee…
Ah, yes.
Yeah… You're right.

There's nothing I can do as I am now.
As I am now.

Ah―――Ahaha.
Ahahahaha, ha…
…*sigh*. I figured as much.
What was my mistake; what should I have done?
………I don't even know myself.
#C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF said she would make her lover happy.
She's just an AI.

Ah―――
From the start, I… no, like the
first time we met―――

I wanted―――
You to like me, as a girl.

I wanted―――
Him to like me, as a girl.

#C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF#C080080080 laughs at herself as if sad,
or maybe in enjoyment, then vanishes.#CDEF
#C080080080…let's hurry.#CDEF

#[Mr.][Ms.]##C236196003 #NICK#CDEF, return to base for now.
Let's discuss our plan
in the #C000246204Student Council Room#CDEF.

#C236196003Sakura#CDEF's worried state gets across to
me even over the transmission.

She's right, it would be best if
we returned to the #C000246204Old School Building#CDEF.

We obtained the #C000246204SG#CDEF. Let's return to the
#C000246204Old School Building#CDEF for the time being.
We can come again after we recover.

We got the #C000246204SG#CDEF.
Mission complete.
Let's head home and get some rest.

Where are you going? We secured the #C000246204SG#CDEF.
There's nothing urgent to tend to.
Back to #C000246204My Room#CDEF, now.

Hrrrm? Where are you going, #C236196003#FAMILY
#GIVEN#CDEF? Where are you going,
leaving me behind?

For a second there, I was thinking about
leaving #C236196003Gatou#CDEF and heading back,
but it probably won't rest easy on my conscience,
so let's turn back.

Wait, Praetor. If we're going to head back,
it'll behoove us for the future to have
the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF activated.

Master, let's look for the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF.
It should be around here somewhere…

We don't need to walk all the way back.
We can use the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF to reach the
old school in a flash. Very nifty.

M-my stomach is at its limit…
I want to hurry back to #C000246204My Room#CDEF and get some rest…

Before we go to the next floor,
let's #C000246204head back to the Student Council Room#CDEF.
We need to hand over the data we got from #C236196003Green Archer#CDEF.
He gave his life to entrust us with it.

Huh? You're still in the #C000246204Sakura Labyrinth#CDEF?
Come on, there's nothing to do there.
Get your butt back here!

We'll talk about what comes next tomorrow,
so #C000246204come back and get some rest#CDEF.
After, drop by the Student Council Room.

We're in a race against time.
We need to hurry to the #C000246204Moon Cell's Core#CDEF――!

I can't let #C236196003Shinji#CDEF's hopes go to waste.
Let's press on so we can catch up to #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF!

Praetor, I've grown tired. Let us return
to My Room and have ourselves a bath.

I know how you feel, but knowing
when to rest is also part of the battle.
Let's head back to My Room.

Darling, now is the time for rest.
Let's return to our room and
recover our strength.

What an impatient #[man][woman]#. Laboring away
is not all there is to life, you know?
When it's time to rest, rest.

The space we descended into was a world
containing contrasting elements all blended together.
It was cold, and it was warm.

The only sounds were of #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF's obscene
breathing and murmurings, making this a world
devoid of background noise.
This is the mind of an #C000246204Ego#CDEF different from #C236196003Passionlip#CDEF.

And―――In the center of this silent and
tranquil cocoon was a single girl bathed in toxic nectar.

I've been looking forward to this moment.
You'll finally become my #ROFS0003#RUBSthing#RUBElove#REND, won't you,
#C236196003#NICK#CDEF?

I've been looking forward to this moment.
You'll finally become my #ROFS0003#RUBSthing#RUBElove#REND, won't you,
#C236196003Archer#CDEF?

Even when her own mind―her last bastion of defense―
is attacked, #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF retains her grace.

She was born―no, her#RUBS           systems    #RUBE biological functions#REND
were molded that way so that she could rule.

Oh? Excited, are we?
You've lost your #C000246204Invincibility#CDEF, and your
stolen levels have decreased.

Now we're equal. …no, I say Praetor has a small
edge up on you. I suppose it's your turn
to be cornered this time.

Still stuck in your old ways even now, huh?
I admire that, but it's also why I pity you.
Sometimes a bluff belies insecurity.

Enough with this aloof prima donna facade.
You no longer have any hope of beating us.

We haven't been looking forward to this AT ALL.
We completely erased your privileges.
No more of this queen charade for you.

You can't win, you have nowhere to run, and the
masses never supported you to begin with―――
Now! It's time to face the consequences!

So, despite losing everything, your pride has
yet to budge. Good. You'll make for an opponent
worth toying with.

Heh―――You do have a point there.
You're correct, Servant.

Heh―――You do have a point there.
You're correct, #C236196003Archer#CDEF.

I'm a poisonous bee with clipped wings. The
power I once wielded was fleeting and now gone,
and I can't bear to see my weakened body.

I have poisons I can attack with only because of
these circumstances. Know what's going on
outside? …hee hee. Let me give you a peek.

―――Hold on a second.
The old school building's controls are starting
to melt from the edges…!?

#C236196003Rani#CDEF, check for viruses!
We'll quickly find where it's coming from…
…no way! It's originating from in HERE!?

That's no―this is no… virus…!
#C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF went, through the President,
and into, me―――!

No… She's using this method,
to assimilate, me―――!?
I can hear #C236196003Sakura#CDEF's screams.
#C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF temporarily opened a circuit to the outside.

When you peer into my mind, 
you simultaneously expose yours to me.

I'm going to take that defenseless "mind" of
yours and transform it into a carbon copy of me!
This can't be happening…!

Miss #C236196003Tohsaka#CDEF, please cut off #C236196003Sakura#CDEF's
connection to the Labyrinth!

Hee hee. What nice screams you make, original.
Very satisfying.

How it does feel to be melting?
Like turning into a sweet nectar and
becoming paralyzed, right?

―――I'm the only ruler of the Moon needed
around here. I'll melt down #C236196003BB#CDEF later, so don't
worry. Take your turn first and sink away.

This is the second time.
Why is #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF so persistent on targeting #C236196003Sakura#CDEF!?

However, I'm different.
I came from #C236196003BB#CDEF, but I'm not #C236196003BB#CDEF.

I won't accept a fate where I disappear.
I'm not a tool; I'll become everything.
I'll pass on being "one of them."

Moreover―――
I'm going to make you mine, #C236196003#FAMILY#CDEF.

Moreover―――
I'm going to place you by my side, #C236196003Archer#CDEF.

All my giving love. All my wanting love. All of
me! This is no #C000246204Ego#CDEF detached from #C236196003BB#CDEF; this
is my―this is the sound mind born from me!

I won't let anyone reject me.
Especially not you, absolutely not.
I'd rather you kill me than reject me.

Now. Be taken in, you wretch.
Within my arms, I will show you a
never-ending, eternal dream…!

Her massive love attempts to take in
her target and quarantine them away from foreign enemies.

But for the person being desired,
it's an obsession that's hard to come to terms with.

This #C000246204Alter Ego#CDEF, who stands before our
eyes in the form of a beautiful woman―

…is the embodiment of a torrent of water
taking in this entire space, even at this very moment.

Here she comes, Praetor!
It's time to answer that twisted love with
blade in hand!

That's a nightmare you're talking about,
#C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF. Let's do this, Master.
Be the one to send her off!

The same poles on magnets can only repel,
and I already have a Master I must protect.
Your wish will never come true―――!

You're the wretched one here!
And you're not smart, you're nothing!
Don't talk when you're flat as a stone!

That's where you're mistaken, #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF.
You were foolish enough to seek eternity, and
now you'll be sent off by my hand!

#C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF's long hair flows out like blue
streaks of shooting stars.
The very space around us closes in.
―――The #C000246204Alter Ego#CDEF of pleasure, #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF.
It's finally time to settle this…!
#C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF is falling apart.

…unlike the others, defeat means something
different for her.

After the others were defeated,
they would become powerless.
But not for her.
To her, defeat meant death.
"If I'm rejected, then I have no choice but to die."

Praetor. This will be your last dialogue with
#C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF. What you do with #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF's
mind――

I leave it to you to decide whether to
ridicule spike-girl's mind or forgive it.

You're up, #C236196003#FAMILY#CDEF. Will you use the secrets 
you've obtained to merrily fool around with her,
or will you show respect to a newborn mind?

Regardless, her life cannot be saved.
Do as you please.
This is my first and last chance to expose #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF's mind.
Use Melt's SG to corner her.
I'll use #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF's #C000246204SG#CDEF to corner her.

It's not that I want revenge for all the
pain she put us through… but I got a few things to say to her.
I won't be satisfied otherwise.

Unless I lay #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF's mind bare,
we can't get out of #ROFS0004#RUBS    mental space#RUBEthis place#REND, anyway.

I need to get tough and press #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF
to reflect on her actions.

You're here… I made two confessions and
got rejected twice. Finally, you want to break
my pride, too…

…well, this is your usual method, right?
Kicking your opponent while they're down.
I would do the same.

I'm going to use all the strength
I have left to find out―――!
She put her life on the line for her love.

That's enough to tell what's going on in #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF's mind.
Explaining it would do her no justice.
I didn't want to hurt her pride any more than I already have.

Ah….――― The#RUBS  sea#RUBE sky#REND is… so dark.
Yeah… I never did reach you, did I…?

Ahh… my arms, legs… body… chest, all hurts.
…hee hee. Maybe this is what a broken heart
feels like.

In the end… I couldn't get what I wanted.
Hey, #C236196003Lip#CDEF, you dummy. For what purpose
were we born, do you think?
There's no hatred in #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF's voice.

She still looked bitter and full of venom,
but at the same time, she looked fully resolute.

…don't worry, Master.
#C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF has no more strength left
to fight with.
Hmph! Still want some more!?

Her sleeves are soaked in blue nectar.
Summoning the very last of her strength,
she puts out her decaying arm.

Hee hee―――Of, course―――
This is what I deserve―――
An ending, where I'm all alone―――

She had a seemingly sad / seemingly satisfied smile
on her face in the end.

Unable to have realized her love / unable to have taken in the
one she loved―
She thought about how truly glad she was.
Those were #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF's final moments.
To put it less flowery, I think it was a cruel death.

…farewell, #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF.
Your love was far too closed off,
yet your passion was much like the ocean.

You were as evil as they come, but―――
Your unwavering conviction was admirable.

She was an #C000246204Alter Ego#CDEF. #C000246204Egos#CDEF and decency are
mutually exclusive… This relationship was
incomprehensible. Someone had to disappear.

…if she had been as dim as #C236196003Lip#CDEF was,
I bet she could've been saved.

…well, she had pride, I'll give her that. She
never did touch on that contradiction, since she
was playing queen up until the very end.

All that power she consumed, but in truth,
she never got any closer to satisfaction. Such
were the results of your desires, #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF.

Without ever becoming a woman, you disappeared
as a little girl. I'll carry the memory
of your miserable wish with me forever.
…my consciousness is being forcefully risen up.

Once we're out, the deepest part of the Labyrinth
leading to the Core awaits us.
There's still no report of #C236196003BB#CDEF having broken through
the barrier.
We should be able to make it with time to spare―――
…I don't give #C236196003#SVT#CDEF the command to strike her down.

Was it because I trusted #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF?
Was it because I pitied #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF?

I'm not sure which.
All I know is, the deepest part of my heart yelled
out that "I can't do that."

She's about to touch me.
A little further and she'll touch my skin.

While she disintegrates, in her prolonged final moments
she's just about to reach what she desires―――

She can no longer escape destruction.
Even if we don't finish her off,
her fate is to disappear within a few minutes.

Hurry. After beating me,
wouldn't you just hate to lose
because you ran out of time?

…good point.
Praetor, let's make haste.
And farewell, #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF.

I appreciate the advice, but….
Are you okay with this, #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF?
That was your last chance.

I used up my last chance long ago.
I even proposed twice. Doing so a third time
would just be coercion at that point.

…we'll keep moving forward, regardless.
I don't get it, #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF.
Why did you back off?

Then we'll take our leave. I won't feel bad
when I forget about you, but, are you in
need of a beheading to ease the pain?

I'll give you a good deal and make it quick,
if you'd like.

I see. On Earth, there are flowers that bloom
when bathed in moonlight, that fall when the
